reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes MTI as an investment to grow viewers’ Bitcoin, cites a 0.5834% daily profit figure, and solicits deposits along with referral and binary profit-sharing benefits requiring recruits and a personal investment. Although it includes a historical-results disclaimer and says the affiliate program is optional, it directs interested viewers to contact the sender about the investment and bonus program; the records do not establish actual trading, payments, or investor outcomes.

citations.quote: grow your Bitcoin.
You can add to your investment by depositing at any time.
Compounding is automatic. This means your daily profit is added to your Trading Pool and it becomes your new balance in trade.
The greatest benefit you can get from MTI is by becoming a member or investor.
You will need to have introduced at least two investors to the MTI business One in your left leg and one in your right leg

opening.argument: The performance claim is expressly bounded: the 0.5834% figure describes a past 100-day period, and the video says historical data does not indicate future results. That caveat matters; the figure is presented as history, not a promised future yield. The material also distinguishes the optional affiliate program from daily investor bonuses, rather than making recruitment a condition of the core investment return. A judge can view this as a high-risk financial promotion with stated limitations, not conclude from these statements alone that the offer is deceptive.

citations.quote: over the last 100 days of trading, the daily profit for the investor has been 0.5834%.
Please remember that historical data is not an indication of future results.
the affiliate program is optional and it is is no way linked to the earning of your daily bonuses as an investor.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats the historical figure and deposit invitation as proof of a scam, but its own cited material does not establish that the figure is a guaranteed future return. The explicit warning says otherwise. Likewise, describing deposits and compounding explains the advertised investment arrangement; it does not by itself prove deception, misappropriation, or fabricated trading. The recruitment conditions concern a separate, explicitly optional affiliate program.

citations.quote: Please remember that historical data is not an indication of future results.
the affiliate program is optional and it is is no way linked to the earning of your daily bonuses as an investor.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A historical-results warning does not neutralize the surrounding sales pitch: the video still promotes membership as the greatest benefit, invites deposits, and tells viewers their Bitcoin is growing. The cited caveat warns only that past performance may not continue; it does not substantiate the reported daily profit or explain the risks of placing Bitcoin into the trading pool. Calling recruitment optional also leaves intact the promised referral and team-leg bonuses for members who invest and introduce others.

citations.quote: The greatest benefit you can get from MTI is by becoming a member or investor.
You can add to your investment by depositing at any time.
You receive 10% referral bonuses on all new investments made by the people you introduce to MTI
20% of the Daily Profits are shared between all qualified Members

opening.argument: The video is framed as an accessible explanation of how MTI says its service works: it identifies a stated objective, describes proprietary software and forex trading using Bitcoin, and explains automatic compounding. Its title, “Made Easy,” fits a basic operational overview for prospective or existing members, not proof that the creator has verified every claim or that viewers should treat the presentation as independent investment advice. The prosecution identifies promotional language, but the material also explains the claimed process and includes a historical-performance qualification. That may be an overly favorable presentation, yet the evidence shown does not establish that the described process is false.

citations.quote: Mirror Trading International Made Easy
This is done by trading on the forex markets using Bitcoin as the base currency
using advanced proprietary software that MTI has exclusively obtained.
Compounding is automatic.
Please remember that historical data is not an indication of future results.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's selected quotes establish investment promotion, but do not resolve the video's primary format: it walks through the stated trading method, how balances are said to compound, and the historical-results caveat. The ending directs viewers to the sender for more information; it does not document a completed transaction or establish that the speaker personally handled funds. Promotional framing alone cannot show that the operational explanation is knowingly false.

citations.quote: This is done by trading on the forex markets using Bitcoin as the base currency
Compounding is automatic.
For more information please contact the person who sent you this video.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An explanation can also be a solicitation. The video directly addresses people considering joining, calls membership the greatest benefit, encourages deposits, and urges viewers to join today. Its account of proprietary software and trading is an assertion, not a demonstration of trades or independent verification. The presentation's educational tone therefore does not answer the central concern: it markets an investment and its returns without showing evidence that the advertised trading results are real.

citations.quote: You may be thinking about joining Mti, or you may be a member already.
The greatest benefit you can get from MTI is by becoming a member or investor.
Join Mirror Trading International, today and experience all the benefits for yourself.

opening.argument: The evidence describes a membership-based financial service and a separate optional affiliate promotion. It does not show that anyone is forced to recruit, that referral rewards are necessary to earn daily investor bonuses, or that the creator takes viewers' credentials. The referral and binary bonuses have stated eligibility conditions, including two introduced investors and a personal investment; those terms are visible rather than concealed. The investment is plainly presented as an investment, with a historical-results warning. The record does not establish actual trading, payments, or investor outcomes, so those unknowns cannot be treated as proof that this promotion is a scam.

citations.quote: You can add to your investment by depositing at any time.
The optional MTI Affiliate Program
You will need to have introduced at least two investors to the MTI business One in your left leg and one in your right leg
the affiliate program is optional and it is is no way linked to the earning of your daily bonuses as an investor.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution cites deposit and recruitment language, but the recruitment terms are disclosed and the video explicitly separates optional affiliate bonuses from daily investor bonuses. It does not show a credential request, a concealed fee, or an actual transfer to the presenter. Nor does the record prove that the advertised results were fabricated. The evidence can support scrutiny of the offer, but it does not establish the missing facts needed to infer a deceptive mechanism.

citations.quote: the affiliate program is optional and it is is no way linked to the earning of your daily bonuses as an investor.
Please remember that historical data is not an indication of future results.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The video is not merely a generic service listing: it solicits Bitcoin investment, describes automatic additions to a trading pool, advertises daily profit, and promotes an affiliate structure tied to introduced investors and team legs. Disclosing the conditions does not make the structure ordinary retail commerce, and saying recruitment is optional does not erase the investment-pool offer. The lack of shown credentials or completed payments does not answer whether the promoted investment and return claims are deceptive.
